liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer found it soulful but a downer, with Touch of Grey offering little uplift afterward; After Stella Blue, the original plan was The Wheel, then Good Lovin', with Black Muddy River as encore [2][6]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [8]
- **Scarlet Bogonias**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **The Other One Jam**: back after 91 archived shows (928 days); rare: 4 archived performances [8]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Alabama Getaway [8]

## The recordings

- **dac2018-05-30.mbhoka200.akgck63actives.flac16.matrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 182 min [1]
- **DeadCo2018-05-30**: source not stated; 18 songs; 181 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **deadco2018-05-30.akgck63.nbobactives.flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 183 min [4]
- **deadco2018-05-30.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 183 min [3]

## Around the show

- Show started around 7:30, which collided with the strict 11:00 curfew at the end of the night [6]
- Planned closing songs were The Wheel, Good Lovin and Black Muddy River, but they were cut; Oteil soloed nicely and John used one guitar [6]
- No encore, and the setlist was altered because of the hard 11pm curfew [2]
- Reviewer says it was neither their best nor longest show, but still tasty, with Bobby and band sounding strong [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dac2018-05-30.mbhoka200.akgck63actives.flac16.matrix**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: DFC/OTS _> MBHO603/ka200n -> V3(24/48) + AKGck63/Nbob actives -> Tascam DR-680 (Busman Mod) [1]
- **DeadCo2018-05-30**: taped by Jay; transferred by Jay; source: Schoeps MK4's>Schoeps CMR's>Naiant PFA>Edirol R-44 (OCM) [2]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps MK4 mics and CMR capsules through Naiant PFA to Edirol R-44, from Section 6, Row N [2]
- **deadco2018-05-30.akgck63.nbobactives.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: AKGck63(din)/nBob Actives/Naiant pfa's-> Tascam DR-680/Busman Mod (24/48) [4]. Also: Transfer used Sound Forge 11 with left channel volume adjustment and normalization, then FLAC encoding via TLH [4]
- **deadco2018-05-30.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHO603/ka200n(dina)->V3(24/48)-> Tascam DR-680 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [dead and company poster - Xfinity center - Manchester MA, May 30 2018 | #4206676388](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/dead-company-poster-xfinity-center-4206676388) [9]
